claim_limits: Assessment only: no fitting, parameter changes or adoption.
Official decision-24 objective is 48 fitted pressure plus 94 fitted species targets (142 total).
Existing compare.py cost rows labelled 160 or 180 are historical broader re-scores, not the official 142-target objective.
100-120 C pressure is out-of-range reporting, by source; not gated or qualified for stripper use.
The 80 C packet isotherm is held out of the fit; canonical T=80 C rows are a distinct 21-row view.
15 and 45 wt% rows are the existing composition second look, not untouched validation.
Jakobsen carbonate is the fraction of dissolved carbon; model interpolated in loading by the unchanged scorer.
NaHCO3 comparison uses 60 evaluated Pitzer-fit values, 278.15-318.15 K and 0.001-1 mol/kg water, at 101.325 kPa, with unrefitted sodium; indicative only.
No uncertainty propagation or physical validation is established by this evaluation.
